subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin support receiving non-mention Space messages, and if so should that be implemented through user OAuth, Workspace Events app subscriptions, or a narrower service-account-only policy?
rationale: The remaining request changes Google Chat credential storage, scopes, admin/user consent, event delivery architecture, and fallback behavior; automation can verify the gap but cannot choose the permanent security and product boundary.

options.title: Approve A Plugin-Local Auth/Event Design
options.body: Keep the issue open and require a maintainer-approved design that uses existing SecretRef/redaction patterns and preserves service-account webhook behavior before implementation.

options.title: Keep Mention-Gated Service Account Only
options.body: Close or narrow the all-message portion as not planned, leaving Google Chat spaces to process only delivered @mention events plus current service-account sends.

options.title: Consolidate Into Existing Google Chat Items
options.body: Move the OAuth portion under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9764 and the thread-routing portion under the open thread PRs before closing this umbrella.

recommendation.title: Approve A Plugin-Local Auth/Event Design
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require a maintainer-approved design that uses existing SecretRef/redaction patterns and preserves service-account webhook behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest observed combination of recent Google Chat code history, current-line blame, and prior maintainer-side review context for the OAuth/security boundary.
